description: Card B2's cruiser: an 1863 cc 45-degree V-twin, redline 5,500.

targets.name: Starts and runs
targets.source: a warm engine started on its key runs (engine.state 2)

targets.name: Within full scale
targets.source: 02-contracts.md, section 1: what process writes is within +-1

targets.name: Holds the limiter
targets.source: a fuel-cut or ignition-cut rev limiter holds the speed within a few percent of where it cuts

targets.name: Peak torque
targets.source: a 1.9 L cruiser twin makes about 155 to 165 N m at 3,000 rpm (Harley-Davidson's claim for the 114: 155 N m). Reported, not failed: a miss until the engine's breathing and friction at high piston speed are right (card B2's handoff).

targets.name: Peak power
targets.source: a 1.9 L cruiser twin makes some 65 to 75 kW (Harley-Davidson's Milwaukee-Eight 114: about 70 kW claimed; Cycle World measured some 89 hp, 66 kW, at the wheel). Reported, not failed: as above.
